verdict.rationale: Zero partly covers the transparency half of the story. It states that it does not track, collect, or sell your data, and it discloses that user emails are stored in Durable Objects and an R2 bucket. Nothing in the evidence shows it blocks senders' read pixels or remote images, by default or otherwise. missing for 10: blocking of tracking pixels/remote content by default, sender-tracking protection settings, detailed privacy policy or data-handling documentation, independent corroboration
